description: This file defines a Java interface 'TransactionDao' for data access operations related to 'Transaction' entities, specifically extending a generic DAO and adding a method to list transactions by order.

classes.name: TransactionDao
classes.description: A Java interface for Transaction data access, extending a generic DAO and including a method to retrieve transactions associated with a specific order.

methods.name: listByOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Transaction objects associated with the given Order.
